2.

The present Application has been filed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 to direct the trial court to consider the bail application of the applicant in the light of the guidelines,

4. The present Application has not been opposed by the State.

5. In view of the above, the present Application, filed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, is disposed of with a direction to the Trial Court concerned that in case, the applicant moves an application for bail in Criminal Case No.290 of 2022 (Case Crime No.406 of 2021, registered at police station Rishikesh, District Dehradun), the Trial Court concerned shall Neeraj Singh Chauhan vs State Of Uttarakhand And Another on 17 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/167457547/
